{{Season|Summer}} |Weather = Any weather |Difficulty = 3 |Behavior = Floater |Size = 1 - 2 in |XP = 4 |Edibility = 2 |base = 15 |Roe = yes }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a type of [[Fish]] that can be caught at [[Stardew:The Mountain|The Mountain]] during {{Season|Spring}}, at any time, in any weather. {{TOC|limit=2}} ==Map== {|class="wikitable" | style="background-color:unset;"|[[File:Fish Zone Mountain.png|center|500px|class=responsive-image]] |- | style="text-align:center;"|The Mountain - Fish Zones |} {{clear}} ==Gifting== {{PAGENAME}} is a universally '''disliked''' gift item, with the following exceptions: {{Gifting |like=Sebastian |neutral=Demetrius, Elliott, Linus, Pam, Sebastian, Willy |hate=Evelyn, Haley, Pierre, }} ==Fish Pond== {{#lst:Fish|Tadpole}} ==Recipes== {{PAGENAME}} is not specifically used in any artisan, cooking, or crafting recipes but can be used in recipes calling for "Any Fish." ==Bundles== When '''"SVE Bundles"''' is selected in the [[Configuration Options]], {{PAGENAME}} is used to complete the {{Bundle|Lake Fish|32|y}}. When '''"Hard SVE Bundles"''' is selected, a quantity of 3 are required to complete the bundle. ==Quests== {{PAGENAME}} is not used in any quests. ==Tailoring== {{DyePot|gray}} When used in dyeing, {{PAGENAME}} produces a gray color. ==History== * v.1.15: Introduced
